title: 第25章 流民居住区第26章 秋后算账
slug: 灵气复苏我有个吞噬系统
content_zh:
第二颗通脉丹下肚，丘凌风的第六条主经脉几乎就要被贯通。
只不过，还是差了一丝。
“还是差了点，不过距离突破也快了。”
丘凌风心中想道。
通脉丹的确是个好东西，两颗下肚，不到十几分钟的时间，就让他省下了大半个月的修炼时间。
这时，郝秀等人也都回来了。
他们也都是打包带回来的。
众人一起吃完饭，叶宇城则是给众人发了一段讯息。
上面记载的就是金澜城外流民居住区会出现的各种魔兽的外貌和等级。
众人接下来的时间就都在消化这些信息。
时间差不多之后，丘凌风几人就和张小男四人汇合了。
而后，八人一同朝着金澜城外走去。
“你们知道城外会出现的魔兽有哪些吗？”
丘凌风朝着张小男问道。
“看了，叶恋之前发给了我们很多关于魔兽的信息，说是叶宇城发给她的。”
张小男说话间，还看了一眼叶宇城，道，
“话说，凌风，你们宿舍的叶宇城，有没有女朋友啊？”
“这个我不清楚，我也没问过。”
丘凌风耸了耸肩道。
“那你帮我问问，你别想多啊，我替我一个朋友问的。”

张小男道。
“你说的这个朋友，她是不是……”
丘凌风有些狐疑的看了一眼张小男。
“不是，你可别想多了。”
张小男急忙否认。
“那行吧，我现在就去问问他。”
丘凌风点了点头，准备去问叶宇城有没有女朋友。
结果张小男直接拉住了他，慌张的道：
“你傻了啊你，你现在问？等我们回来之后你再问他。”
“哦……”
丘凌风额头一黑，应道。
“对了，凌风，今天早上晓灵师姐找你有什么事情吗？”
张小男又问道。
“哦，师姐她叫我别怠慢了修行，早日进入内院，总之不是什么大事。”
content_en:
With the second Tongmai Pill in his stomach, Qiu Lingfeng's sixth main meridian was almost connected.
However, there is still a slight difference.
"It's still a little bit off, but we're closer to a breakthrough."
Qiu Lingfeng thought in his heart.
The Tongmai Pill is indeed a good thing. Two pills saved him more than half a month of practice time in less than ten minutes.
At this time, Hao Xiu and others also came back.
They also brought them back in packages.
After everyone finished eating together, Ye Yucheng sent a message to everyone.
What is recorded above is the appearance and level of various magical beasts that will appear in the refugee settlements outside Jinlan City.
Everyone spent the next time digesting this information.
After the time was almost up, Qiu Lingfeng and the others joined Zhang Xiaonan and the others.
Then, the eight of them walked towards the outside of Jinlan City together.
"Do you know what kind of monsters will appear outside the city?"
Qiu Lingfeng asked Zhang Xiaonan.
"Look, Ye Lian sent us a lot of information about Warcraft before, saying that it was sent to her by Ye Yucheng."
While Zhang Xiaonan was speaking, he glanced at Ye Yucheng and said,
"By the way, Ling Feng, does Ye Yucheng from your dormitory have a girlfriend?"
"I don't know about this, and I didn't ask."
Qiu Lingfeng shrugged.
"Then ask for me. Don't think too much. I'm asking for a friend of mine."
Zhang Xiaonan said.
"This friend you are talking about, is she..."
Qiu Lingfeng glanced at Zhang Xiaonan suspiciously.
"No, don't think too much."
Zhang Xiaonan hurriedly denied it.
"Okay, I'll ask him now."
Qiu Lingfeng nodded and was about to ask Ye Yucheng if he had a girlfriend.
As a result, Zhang Xiaonan grabbed him and said in a panic:
"Are you stupid? Are you asking now? You can ask him again after we come back."
"Oh..."
Qiu Lingfeng's forehead darkened and he responded.
"By the way, Ling Feng, does Senior Sister Xiaoling have anything to do with you this morning?"
Zhang Xiaonan asked again.
"Oh, senior sister, she told me not to neglect my practice and enter the inner courtyard as soon as possible. Anyway, it's not a big deal."
